g.text: How much improvement reaches how many blocks?
Higher gain thresholds distinguish substantial improvements from tiny positive changes
Denominators: A = 999 paired blocks; B = 998 (one failed block excluded). Thresholds describe effect sizes, not constraints.
Every cell uses the same reference pairing. Reference gain is zero by definition; unfavorable outcomes remain in the denominator.
